synopsis: The Komatsu 730E appears alongside the 860E in Wabtec’s first Level 9 validation with Komatsu, conducted in December 2021 at speeds up to 30 km/h [f817]. Chapter 2 and the glossary report that these tests demonstrated controlled deceleration; the mining case is also described as using Level 9 slow-and-stop functionality [f1345, f15781, f1832, f1833]. Chapter 1 states that Wabtec’s Level 9 Collision Awareness System covers both truck models up to 30 km/h [f1073]. For virtual-validation planning, the important limitation is that physical testing still dominated the integration stage in this case; the supplied facts do not establish a virtual-only validation precedent [f1347].
